title: Roast {p} with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the {p} very dry, then rub with oil, salt and the {spice}.
Roast the {p} on a sheet pan until {doneness}: about 25 to 45 minutes for pieces (breasts take the least), or about 1 hour 15 minutes for a whole bird. Rest 10 minutes before carving.
While it roasts, get the sides going. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Plate the {p} with the {v} and {s}, and spoon the {sauce} over the top.
tip: Roast extra vegetables on the same pan, and keep the skin to a few bites, for a lighter plate.
